text:
tara: Heads-up: final onsite candidate (L6 infra) scheduled 2pm PT Thursday — panel has 4 ppl but we need a backup. Can someone cover if @adrian is late? Also need a scribe for debrief.
adrian: I'll be on travel that day, flight lands 1:45pm PT. I can join if gate wifi holds but can't guarantee. @priya can you be backup?
priya: I can cover. Do we have the rubric version? Last time there were changes re: system-design weight.
tara: Use rubric v3.1 (https://drive/recruiting/debriefs/finalist-ops-v3.1). Quick notes: system-design 40%, reliability 30%, execution 20%, comms 10%. Score examples are in the doc.
matt: Where's the debrief doc? can't find it in the hiring drive.
tara: ops-bot posted it earlier and pinned it. @ops-bot can you repost the link here?
ops-bot: Auto-post: debrief doc https://drive/recruiting/debriefs/finalist-ops-v3.1 (updated 2026-01-10).
priya: Thanks. Quick Q: for the "availability" incident question, do we score on technical depth or leadership? Rubric says reliability covers both but examples would help.
tara: Score technical depth primarily; add leadership notes in comments. We'll add a one-line example: "candidate describes specific rollback, rollback time, and coordination."
adrian: If I'm late, please run the canary question (ops incident) first; I can join and take system design after I land.
matt: Scribe volunteer: I can take notes and capture raw scores in the sheet.
priya: :thumbsup: Matt, thanks. Can someone drop the interview kit (candidate Slack access + runbook) to me now?
tara: Copy — candidate Slack created (candidate_L6_123). Interview kit below:
```
Candidate channel: #cand-L6-123
Zoom link: https://zoom.company.com/meet/xyz
Runbook: /docs/interviews/runbook.md
```
Please share with panel 24h before.
adrian: Small ask: remind panel to avoid referencing previous takehome during probing. Add a note to the calendar event.
priya: On calendar note — I'll add: "Do not mention prior takehome. Focus on blue-team ops questions."
tara: Perfect. Matt — after debrief, can you upload raw scores to the hiring drive and tag me? I'll handle calibration.
matt: Yep, will upload within 1h post-interview.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: debrief nudge 15m after interview end to participants: tara, adrian, priya, matt.
tara: Thanks all. Final check: backup cover confirmed (priya), scribe confirmed (matt). I'll update the calendar with rubric link and the 'no takehome' note.
